brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine the effect of intermittent fasting on insulin secretion and insulin sensitivity in skeletal muscle and fat distribution.
brief_title: Short Term Intermittent Fasting and Insulin Resistance

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI 28-35
* Type 2 diabetes or metabolically healthy
* Diet or orally administered treatment for type 2 diabetes

Exclusion Criteria:

* Regular physical activity
* Other diseases than type 2 diabetes
* insulin treatment
* alcohol abuse

official_title: Effects of Short Term Intermittent Fasting on Insulin Resistance in Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Change from Baseline in Insulin Sensitivity after 20 days of intermittent fasting.

sites.facility: Xlab, Department of Biomedical Sciences, University of Copenhagen
